note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary literals and scalar variables. It has no functions, classes, or callable code. It defines model architecture, training schedule, and optimizer settings for Grid R-CNN with ResNet-50 backbone on COCO.
summarize_model_config: summarize the Grid R-CNN model configuration with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck for COCO detection
review_train_cfg: review the training configuration including RPN assigner sampler and RCNN grid settings
review_optimizer_config: review the SGD optimizer settings with learning rate 0.02 and weight decay 0.0001
review_param_scheduler: review the learning rate scheduler with LinearLR warmup and MultiStepLR milestones at epochs 17 and 23
review_test_cfg: review the test configuration including NMS threshold 0.3 and max 100 detections per image
